additions:
Known authoring facts and reference examples (not extra domain requirements):
        - A spec's own ACR comes from its filename, not SPEC_ID, scope, or directory. For
          `<name>.spec.md`, split name on hyphens: multiple words use uppercase initials;
          one word uses its first three letters uppercase. `normalize.spec.md` -> NOR at any
          nesting depth; `cache-policy.spec.md` -> CP. New local IDs are `NOR-REQ-1` / `NOR-DL-1`.
          Parent requirement IDs stay unchanged when cited; do not rename or clone them as local IDs.
        - Markdown hrefs resolve from the document's directory, not the repository root.
          From `specs/catalog/normalize/normalize.spec.md`, `[Parent](../catalog.spec.md)`;
          from `specs/catalog/pipeline/normalize/normalize.spec.md`, `[Parent](../../catalog.spec.md)`.
          Append an existing literal SECTION anchor, e.g. `#REQUIREMENTS_AND_CONSTRAINTS`, only
          when that section actually exists in the referenced file. Read the named owner, not a search
          for a different filename or an invented format file.
        - The Decision Log uses one line, not a Status/Recorded block; no separate
          decision-log-format.xml exists. The full one-line grammar is in the Decision Log contract
          inside `ai/directives/sdd-v2/root.directive.xml`; use the self-contained example here.
          New entry shape: `<ACR>-DL-1 <YYYY-MM-DD> — <decision> (почему: <reason>)` on one line;
          disputed autonomous choices append `[verdict: pending-operator]` as already specified above.
